agent.problem: The question depends on "Hazael hears this" and "such a monstrous thing," but it never says what Elisha has just told him. These phrases point back to card 12, so the question does not supply its own context once that story card is off screen.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
